build_docker_image_setup: build a Docker image setup step with FROM, SHELL, and debian dependencies using DockerFBCodeBuilder
run_docker_shell_command: run a shell command inside a Docker container using the run method with RUN instruction
copy_local_repo_to_container: copy a local repository into the Docker container as a tar archive with proper ownership
setup_docker_ccache: setup ccache in the Docker build environment to speed up repeated C/C++ compilation steps
set_docker_workdir: set the working directory in the Docker image with proper mkdir and chown for the configured user
